column1: Vocabulary surfaced during interactive COSYevents club sessions (Speaking Clubs, Cinema, Karaoke, Long Reads, science and discussion clubs), taken from Markdown frontmatter and HTML vocabulary cards.
Scope: 12 club folders, 1,597 unique English terms; 869 already existed in COSYdata, 27 non-unit or metadata cards skipped, 701 new entries added.
Primary batch file: cosyevents-vocabulary.json (enriched, with provenance). Human-editable export: english.csv.
• Review english.csv for the flat export; use cosyevents-vocabulary.json for a repeatable importer run.
• Then run: npm run build && npm run validate
• Refer to PLAN.md for schema alignment, enrichment sources, and taxonomy rules.
Multilingual batch (2026-11-28): 481 new entries across French (223), Russian (125), Greek (53), Italian (46), Spanish (34).
82 terms already existed and were linked; 10 cards skipped (plural phrases, proper names, acronym, grammatical form).
Machine-readable files: vocabulary-export-fr.json, vocabulary-export-ru.json, vocabulary-export-el.json, vocabulary-export-it.json, vocabulary-export-es.json.
Run node scripts/import-events-vocab.cjs <file>, then npm run build and npm run validate. Report: reports/cosyevents-import-multilang-2026-11-28.json.
Level review: 198 entries recalibrated after comparing source cards with English concept levels and target-language frequency. Final levels: A2=35, B1=273, B2=161, C1=12.
